title: Su Teutap .
intro: Ureueng nyoe geuingat keu hikmah dan bimbingan nyang mendalam, geubri nasihat nyang meulangkah keu generasi-generasi. Kata-kata awaknyan na kheueh saboh bukti keuhai taqwa dan peunteng that ta akui nikmat dan cobaan nibak Ilahi. Buka identitas jiwa nyang terhormat nyoe.
clues: Lon kon nabi, tapi hikmah lon geuabadikan lam Kitab Ilahi.
Naseuhat lon keu aneuk lon teugaih syukur keu Allah dan peujioh droe dari syirik.
Lon peurunoe teuntang peunteng jih seumayang, peurintah nyang jroh, dan peularang buet nyang brok.
Ulôn peuingat mangat bék sombong dan tajak ngon sombong di ateueh bumoe.
Nan lon geubri keu saboh mandum surah lam Al-Quran, nyang menyorot ajaran lon.
Naseuhat ulôn nakeuh keusabaran dalam keuadaan keunong keunong, sabab memang, njan nibak njang paléng teugaih nibak urusan.

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Naseuhat nyang bijaksana keu sidroe keuturonan .
location.answer: Naseuhat nyang bijaksana keu sidroe keuturonan .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Hikmah gobnyan ka teucatat lam Al-Quran .
Geupimpén umat Gobnyan u nanggroe nyang barô .
outcome.answer: Hikmah gobnyan ka teucatat lam Al-Quran .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
